senses.gloss:
गौतमः N. of (1) the sage Bhāradvāja; (2) of Śatānanda, Gotamaʼs
 son; (3) of Kṛpa, Droṇaʼs brother-in-law; (4) of Buddha; (5) of the
 propounder of the Nyāya system of philosophy.
.━{@Comp.@}: गौतमसम्भवा

—1 N. of Kṛpī, wife of Droṇa.
—2 An epithet of the Godāvarī.
—3 The teaching of Buddha.
—4 The Nyāya system of philosophy propounded by Gautama.
—5 Turmeric.
—6 A kind of yellow pigment.
—7 An epithet of Durgā. —8 N. of the river Gomatī.
